title: Australian Fish Bake with Jelly Glaze
description: A unique Indian-inspired fish dish with a sweet and tangy jelly glaze. Serve with a side of basmati rice or naan bread.

ingredients.name: Like (such as cumin, coriander, and turmeric)
Bake (such as lemon and garlic)
ingredients.notes: Mix of lemon zest and minced garlic

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together the like spices and bake.
Place the fish fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Brush the jelly glaze over the fish fillets, making sure to coat them evenly.
Sprinkle the like spice and bake mixture over the fish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the fish hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
Serve with a side of basmati rice or naan bread.
